verdict.rationale: First-party docs show that `tofu plan` builds an execution plan for previewing infrastructure changes before applying them. It also supports speculative plans, a destroy-mode plan and a refresh-only plan, and `-out=FILE` saves a plan so that exactly that plan is executed by `tofu apply`. missing for 10: explicit documentation that plan output itemizes creates, updates and destroys per resource, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the plan preview.
